Initial release.

- Convert written text scripts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT up to 10MB) into animated explainer videos with narration.
- Cloud-based GPU processing delivers 1080p MP4 files in 1-2 minutes.
- Simple setup: automatic token and session management with clear status updates.
- Supports file upload, script editing, video preview, and export commands via chat.
- Integrated error handling and session continuity for iterative editing and batch processing.
